items.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: So it was a great band... Aaron Sachs, Shorty Rodgers, Clyde Lombardi, Specs Powell and Hank Cohoot on piano.

ctx.x: So it was a great band. And I’m trying to get some recordings of that band out. We were two days in George Simon’s house recording, because it was a recording ban, in ’42. And we were at The Famous Door so we were rehearsed and the band was tight. A good band. Aaron Sachs, Shorty Rodgers, Clyde Lombardi, Specs Powell and Hank Cohoot on piano.
What did the musicians in general think about that recording ban?
